Hymn 312: We Ever Pray for Thee
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: H. A. Tuckett
Lyricist/Text Author: Evan Stephens
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 312 titled "We Ever Pray for Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by H. A. Tuckett and the lyrics were written by Evan Stephens.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
